profile.name: Thomas Gabriel de Souza Barros
profile.headline: Unity, multiplayer/online, WebGL, Three.js, VR/AR, simulation, and backend for interactive products.
about: I am a Unity/C# developer with hands-on experience across commercial games, simulators, metaverse products, WebGL apps, VR/AR, 3D viewers, and real-time connected systems.

I like joining complex projects and turning prototypes into maintainable products: modular architecture, internal tooling, build pipelines, API integration, multiplayer, telemetry, Addressables, and clear documentation.
Recent projects include Battle of Herone, Dungebra, Forklift Simulator, MedRoom Anatomy Web, VirtualTown, AviaXR, Vuzix Remote Assistance, Showmaker Multiscreen, and game launchers/updaters.
My focus is building systems teams can maintain, extend, and ship without losing speed.

projects.title: Forklift / Simulator Platform
projects.description: Training simulation ecosystem with Unity, real-time backend, telemetry, and WebGL/standalone builds.
projects.longDescription:
Current 2026 project evolving from a forklift simulator into a modular training simulation platform.

- Unity client with forklift physics, interactive exercises, checkpoints, HUD, and execution flow.
- Modular architecture across Simulator Core, Simulator Assets, and Manager Studio.
- Addressables, ScriptableObjects, and authoring systems for scenes, vehicles, cargo, and exercises.
- WebSocket/Socket.IO integration for remote commands, telemetry, and real-time synchronization.
- NestJS backend with JWT, Redis, MongoDB/MySQL, and simulation data persistence.
- WebGL/standalone builds and multi-environment delivery flow.

projects.title: MedRoom Anatomy Web
projects.description: Medical 3D viewer with Three.js, Next.js, and a plugin-engine architecture for anatomical GLB models.
projects.longDescription:
Web platform for exploring medical 3D anatomy models such as Lucy, Max, heart, and teeth.

- Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, react-three-fiber, and drei.
- GLB model pipeline with Draco, KTX2/Basis, and Meshopt.
- Plugin Engine architecture with ViewerCore, SceneEngine, EventBus, BundleLoader, and isolated plugins.
- 1:1 manifests between GLB and JSON, mesh coverage validation, and per-model i18n.
- Clear separation between pure TypeScript engine code and React UI.
- Related experiments in MedRoom Mobile, Unity WebViewer, and Three.js prototypes.

projects.title: Dungebra
projects.description: Unity 6 roguelike deckbuilder with mathematical combat, deterministic events, localization, and Steam-oriented structure.
projects.longDescription:
Dungebra is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder focused on transparent math, synergies, and execution order.

- Playable vertical slice with run loop, combat, shop, heroes, cards, items, and enemies.
- Deterministic event system for card resolution, stacks, multipliers, resources, and end-of-combat flow.
- Unity 6 structure with Addressables, localization, Input System, and content-ready organization.
- Data-driven technical design to make balancing, new cards, and new mechanics easier.
- GDD and visual briefing documentation for collaboration with artists and UI work.

projects.title: Battle of Herone
projects.description: Steam-published tactical card strategy game with asynchronous multiplayer through API and database.
projects.longDescription:
Battle of Herone is a strategy game focused on tactical battles where players use cards to summon units and control the board.

- Gameplay, card systems, economy, progression, maps, UI, and internal tools built from the ground up.
- Asynchronous multiplayer based on API and database flows, avoiding the need for real-time dedicated servers.
- Unit systems with AI, movement, range, target priority, and battle resolution.
- Steamworks integration and commercial release on Steam.
- Unity editor tooling for content creation, balancing, and maintenance.

projects.title: VRGlass Connected XR Projects
projects.description: Enterprise Unity projects for WebGL, VR, AR, metaverse, Vuzix, multiscreen experiences, and internal tools.
projects.longDescription:
A set of projects developed at VRGlass and related ecosystems, focused on connected experiences and reusable technical foundations.

- VirtualTown / modular metaverse with WebGL/VR, Colyseus, Photon, and Addressables.
- Vuzix remote assistance with Agora.io, chat, video, AR streaming, and industrial workflows.
- AviaXR, Showmaker Multiscreen, Planogram, WebGL translators, and prototypes with AI avatars/lipsync.
- UPM packages, internal package manager, editor tools, and reusable patterns.
- API integration, WebSockets, dynamic content, and multi-platform builds.

projects.title: Mists of Krakovia + Launcher
projects.description: Game jam MMORPG plus a professional Unity UI Toolkit launcher with automatic updates.
projects.longDescription:
Mists of Krakovia started as a game jam MMORPG, focused on rapid prototyping of an open world, combat, progression, and networking.

- Combat, inventory, quests, and progression systems at a compact MMORPG scale.
- Unity UI Toolkit launcher inspired by professional MMORPG launchers.
- Version checks through manifest.json, build download, file validation, extraction, and safer replacement flow.
- Manifest and build hosting using GitHub Pages and GitHub Releases.
- Practical experience with updater flows, fallback handling, and delivery to end users.

projects.title: TRAY-TASKER
projects.description: Lightweight Windows task and routine manager that lives in the system tray.
projects.longDescription:
TRAY-TASKER was created to reduce distractions during work, keeping routines accessible without opening the browser.

- Electron, React, and TypeScript.
- Windows Tray API integration.
- Weekly routines, time blocks, and automatic notifications.
- Open-source structure with clear separation between UI, state, and desktop integrations.

projects.title: AI & Web Product Experiments
projects.description: Web experiments with AI, SaaS, automation, and tools: DreamSelfie, Orbit, POS, VN Factory, and internal automations.
projects.longDescription:
A line of projects focused on web products, tools, and automations beyond the Unity ecosystem.

- DreamSelfie: AI avatar generation with a mobile-first interface.
- Orbit: SaaS dashboard for project management, Kanban, CRM, and productivity.
- Modern POS: point-of-sale system with React, Supabase, and Tailwind.
- VN Factory: visual novel generator with Electron/React and local integration.
- Python automation programs and helper tools for workflow acceleration.
